verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nō·wṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·qā·rə·’î ‘ă·nê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣiḏ·qî baṣ·ṣār hir·ḥaḇ·tā lî ḥān·nê·nî ū·šə·ma‘ tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Psalm of David Answer me when I call O God of my righteousness You have relieved my distress show me grace and hear my prayer
verses.literalPt: OUVE-ME quando eu clamo, ó Deus da minha justiça, na angústia me deste largueza; tem misericórdia de mim e ouve a minha oração.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־ מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’îš ‘aḏ- meh ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî liḵ·lim·māh te·’ĕ·hā·ḇūn rîq tə·ḇaq·šū ḵā·zāḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: How long . . . O men . . . will my honor be maligned How long will you love vanity and seek after lies Selah
verses.literalPt: Filhos dos homens, até quando convertereis a minha glória em infâmia? Até quando amareis a vaidade e buscareis a mentira? (Selá.)

verses.original: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־ הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·‘ū kî- hip̄·lāh Yah·weh ḥā·sîḏ lōw Yah·weh yiš·ma‘ bə·qā·rə·’î ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself the LORD hears when I call to Him
verses.literalPt: Sabei, pois, que o SENHOR separou para si aquele que é piedoso; o SENHOR ouvirá quando eu clamar a ele.

verses.original: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־ תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־ מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: riḡ·zū wə·’al- te·ḥĕ·ṭā·’ū ’im·rū ḇil·ḇaḇ·ḵem ‘al- miš·kaḇ·ḵem wə·ḏōm·mū se·lāh
verses.literal: Be angry yet do not sin on your bed search your heart and be still Selah
verses.literalPt: Perturbai-vos e não pequeis; falai com o vosso coração sobre a vossa cama, e calai-vos. (Selá.)

verses.original: זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי־ צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.literal: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD
verses.literalPt: Oferecei sacrifícios de justiça, e confiai no SENHOR.

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־ יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־ עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm ’ō·mə·rîm mî- yar·’ê·nū ṭō·wḇ nə·sāh- ‘ā·lê·nū ’ō·wr pā·ne·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Many ask Who can show us the good Shine the light of Your face upon us O LORD
verses.literalPt: Muitos dizem: Quem nos mostrará o bem? SENHOR, exalta sobre nós a luz do teu rosto.

verses.original: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯat·tāh śim·ḥāh ḇə·lib·bî mê·‘êṯ də·ḡā·nām wə·ṯî·rō·wō·šām rāb·bū
verses.literal: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound
verses.literalPt: Puseste alegria no meu coração, mais do que no tempo em que se lhes multiplicaram o trigo e o vinho.

verses.original: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šā·lō·wm yaḥ·dāw ’eš·kə·ḇāh wə·’î·šān kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh lə·ḇā·ḏāḏ lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ tō·wō·šî·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: I will lie down and sleep in peace for You alone O LORD make me dwell in safety
verses.literalPt: Em paz também me deitarei e dormirei, porque só tu, SENHOR, me fazes habitar em segurança.
